description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass 'HighlightedMenuItemHostView' that manages a highlighted menu item view with mouse tracking, layout, and drawing capabilities. It also provides a SwiftUI wrapper 'MenuHostedHighlightedItem' for integrating this NSView within SwiftUI views.

classes.name: HighlightedMenuItemHostView
classes.description: An NSView subclass that hosts a SwiftUI view, handling mouse hover state to update highlighting and layout.

methods.name: init(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Initializes the host view with a SwiftUI view and target width, setting up subviews and layout.

methods.name: update(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Updates the hosted view with a new SwiftUI view and width, refreshing highlight state.

methods.name: updateHighlight()
methods.description: Updates the environment to reflect hover state and refreshes layout.

methods.name: updateSizing()
methods.description: Adjusts the frame size based on the hosted view's fitting size and target width.
